description: Century Insurance Company Limited is a general insurer incorporated in Pakistan in 1985, part of the Lakson Group, quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and rated "AA" with a stable outlook by VIS. It underwrites fire, motor, marine, engineering and miscellaneous general insurance along with travel, home, accident and health covers, and also runs window takaful operations.
headOffice: Lakson Square, Building No. 3, 11th Floor, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi-74200, Pakistan
